refusal.policy: refuse entire gradient for invalid indices, nonfinite inputs, singular division and nonfinite intermediates/results

entry_points.adjoint_phases: Launch ad then ad_finalize in that order on the same CUDA stream, checking refusal records before publishing gradients. The incoming output cotangent buffers and outgoing input cotangent buffers are disjoint; the final phase consumes the former.

workspace.refusal_ownership: One int32 slot per source ID; device threads set the slot atomically; any nonzero slot refuses the derivative.
workspace.initialization: zero all records before each launch; inspect all records and refuse the entire derivative if any is nonzero
workspace.aliases: Under COMMON-AD section 36, incoming output cotangents and accumulating input cotangents are separate; other derivative and primal buffers are disjoint.
workspace.accumulation: Each destination has one owner. Duplicate cotangent contributions are gathered in fixed index order into a float64 register, then rounded once into the float32 destination; no unordered floating-point atomics.
workspace.adjoint_phases: Launch ad with phase 0 and inspect refusal records, then ad_finalize with phase 1 on the same stream and inspect again. The second entry clears the consumed output cotangents; input and output cotangent buffers are disjoint.
workspace.refusal_device_layout: int32 per source ID, initialized to zero; any nonzero value refuses the derivative

polynomial_degree_scope: All three outputs on a fixed plus/minus residual arm, with cell-edge topology fixed; IEEE rounding is graded separately.
polynomial_degree_reason: Each increment multiplies the active acoustic sign, upwind flux or horizontal residual, and inverse cell area; the incoming pre-state adds linearly. The plus/minus result is either zero or its signed residual on a fixed arm.
